title: Jubilees Matriarchs, Bar Hebraeus, Tabari, Mas'udi, Islamic Caliphates & Jackson Synchronisms

nodes.name: Yam / Kan'an (Unbelieving Son of Noah Who Perished in the Flood)
nodes.era: Deluge Narrative (Al-Tabari Vol. 1 p. 360; Al-Mas'udi p. 75)
nodes.role: Fourth Pre-Flood Son in Islamic Exegesis
nodes.notes: Recorded alongside Shem, Ham, and Japheth by Al-Tabari and Al-Mas'udi (citing Quran 11:42-44): Noah's son Yam (or Kan'an) refused to board the Ark and perished in the waters.

nodes.name: Book of Jubilees Post-Flood Matriarchs (Rasu'eja, Melka dau. of Madai, Mu'ak, Azura dau. of Nimrod, Lomna, Ora, Milkah, Iyaska & Edna)
nodes.role: Named Post-Flood Matriarchs Connecting Shem, Japheth & Ham Lines
sources: Book of Jubilees (R.H. Charles Ch. 8-11 pp. 66-89)
nodes.notes: Jubilees 8-11 preserves every matriarch from Arphaxad to Abraham: Arphaxad + Rasu'eja (dau. of Elam); Cainan + Melka (dau. of Madai of Japheth!); Shelah + Mu'ak (dau. of Kesed); Eber + Azura (dau. of Nimrod/Nebrod!); Peleg + Lomna (Shinar); Reu + Ora (dau. of Ur); Serug + Milkah; Nahor + Iyaska; Terah + Edna!

nodes.name: Shabokah (Daughter of Japheth & Arbasisah)
nodes.role: Named Daughter of Japheth in Al-Tabari
sources: Al-Tabari Vol. 2 p. 11 (citing Wahb b. Munabbih)
nodes.notes: Al-Tabari records Japheth's wife Arbasisah (daughter of Marazil b. Darmasil of the Cainite line) bearing seven sons and daughter Shabokah.

nodes.name: 'Ad (Prophet Hud) & Thamud (Prophet Salih) — Ancient Arabian Tribes
nodes.era: Early Arabian Peninsula (Al-Tabari Vol. 2 pp. 14-16; Al-Mas'udi p. 76)
nodes.role: Shem -> Aram -> Uz -> Ancient Arab Nations ('Arab al-'Ariba)
nodes.notes: Arabian chroniclers derive the extinct 'original Arabs' ('Ad of al-Ahqaf under Prophet Hud, and Thamud of al-Hijr under Prophet Salih) directly from 'Us (Uz) b. Aram b. Shem b. Noah.

nodes.name: Tasm, Judays, Umaym & 'Imliq (Arabian Amalekites)
nodes.era: Post-Babel Dispersion (Al-Tabari Vol. 2 p. 16; Al-Mas'udi pp. 76-77)
nodes.role: Sons of Lud b. Shem Across Yamamah, Hijaz, Oman & Faris
nodes.notes: Tabari & Mas'udi preserve the Arabian Ludite tribes: Tasm & Judays (Yamamah/Bahrain), Jasim (Oman), 'Imliq (Hijaz/Syria/Amalekite Pharaohs), and Umaym (whose descendants settled Persia/Wabar).

nodes.name: Ya'rub (1st Arabic King), Jurhum (Mecca) & Saba → Himyar & Kahlan (Lakhmids & Ghassanids)
nodes.era: South & North Arabia (Al-Tabari Vol. 2 & 5; Al-Mas'udi p. 78)
nodes.role: Qahtanite / Yemenite Sovereign Stem & Mecca Marriage to Ishmael
sources: MacMichael History of Arabs in Sudan p. 131
nodes.notes: Qahtan (Joktan) -> Ya'rub (said by Mas'udi to be the first king to articulate classical Arabic) & cousin Jurhum (who settled Mecca and married their daughter to Ishmael!) -> Abd Shams Saba -> Himyar (Yemen) & Kahlan (Banu Lakhm of al-Hirah & Ghassanids of Syria).

nodes.name: Al-Rum / Banu al-Asfar (Byzantines/Romans via Esau) & Prophet Job (Ayyub) + Liyya (dau. of Jacob)
nodes.role: Islamic/Arabian Identification of Esau with Rome & Job with Esau's Line
nodes.notes: Al-Tabari transmits the classical Arabic historical tradition identifying al-Rum / Banu al-Asfar (Romans/Byzantines) as descendants of Esau b. Isaac, and tracing Prophet Job (Ayyub b. Maws b. Razih/Raghwil b. Esau) marrying Jacob's daughter Liyya.

nodes.name: Prophet Shu'ayb (Jethro / Reuel of Midian)
nodes.role: Prophet of Midian Descended from Abraham & Keturah
nodes.notes: Mas'udi records the genealogy of Shu'ayb (identified with Jethro/Reuel, father-in-law of Moses): Shu'ayb b. Thoriel b. Da'wayel b. Marik b. 'Anka b. Madyan (Midian) b. Abraham.

nodes.name: Complete 21-Gen Quraysh Lineage (Tabari Vol. 6): Adnan → Ma'add → Nizar → Mudar → Ilyas → Mudrikah → Khuzaymah → Kinanah → al-Nadr → Malik → Fihr (Quraysh) → Ghalib → Lu'ayy → Ka'b → Murrah → Kilab → Qusayy → 'Abd Manaf → Hashim → 'Abd al-Muttalib → 'Abdallah
nodes.role: Unbroken 21-Generation Pedigree from Adnan to the Father of Prophet Muhammad
nodes.notes: Complete 21-generation genealogy preserved in Tabari Vol. 6 (and tabulated by Lane-Poole & Zambaur), linking Adnan (Ishmaelite) down to 'Abdallah b. 'Abd al-Muttalib, father of Muhammad.

nodes.name: Major Islamic Caliphal Houses (Lane-Poole & Zambaur): Umayyads ('Abd Shams), Abbasids (al-'Abbas), Fatimids (Isma'il), Idrisids (Morocco) & Sharifs of Mecca
nodes.role: Caliphal & Royal Houses Descending from Quraysh & Abraham via Ishmael
sources: E. de Zambaur Manuel de Généalogie (1927)
nodes.notes: Complete comparative dynasties from Lane-Poole & Zambaur: 'Abd Manaf -> 'Abd Shams (Umayyad Caliphs of Damascus & Cordoba); Hashim -> al-'Abbas (Abbasid Caliphs of Baghdad); Ali & Fatimah -> Fatimids of Cairo, Idrisids of Morocco & Qatadid Sharifs of Mecca.

nodes.name: Sanchuniathon & Bar Hebraeus Synchronisms: Chrysor/Vulcan (= Tubal-Cain), Misor (= Mizraim), Chna (= Canaan) & 10 Chaldean Kings (Aloros → Ksisothros = Noah)
nodes.era: Antediluvian Comparative Chronology (Jackson 1752 p. 207; Bar Hebraeus p. 6)
nodes.role: Phoenician & Syriac Synchronizations Anchored to Adam & Noah
nodes.notes: John Jackson (1752) aligns Sanchuniathon's Phoenician line (Chrysor/Vulcan = Tubal-Cain in the exact 7th descent from Adam; Misor = Mizraim; Chna = Canaan), while Bar Hebraeus p. 6 preserves the 10 Chaldean kings from Aloros to Ksisothros (= Noah).
